Engineering

Alimentation en Huile de Cylindre

The controlled supply of lubricating oil to the main engine cylinder liners, essential for reducing friction and wear, as specified by engine manufacturer and class.

Questions and answers

What is Alimentation en Huile de Cylindre?

In this glossary, Alimentation en Huile de Cylindre refers to: The controlled supply of lubricating oil to the main engine cylinder liners, essential for reducing friction and wear, as specified by engine manufacturer and class.

How is Alimentation en Huile de Cylindre used in maritime?

In maritime communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Salle des machines, vérifiez le débit d’huile de cylindre et ajustez-le selon la charge moteur et les directives du fabricant."

Definition

The controlled supply of lubricating oil to the main engine cylinder liners, essential for reducing friction and wear, as specified by engine manufacturer and class.

Operational example
